title: One Factory. Multiple applications. N businesses.
intro: GMO Factory sits above the ecosystem and continuously understands, builds and evolves the software underneath it. Select any box to see what it does.

map.aiNote: Agentic intelligence, reasoning and orchestration across the ecosystem

story.pos: operates businesses from Company 1 → Company N.
story.loans: lets people lend money to each other.
story.ai: provide the reasoning and intelligence layer.

factory.title: 🏭 GMO Factory: Autonomous Agentic Software Factory
factory.text: The engineering intelligence above the ecosystem. Its agents understand the business, reason about solutions and evolve the software through governed tools.
items: Understands business needs and the existing ecosystem
Multi-agent reasoning with a Decision Gate
Agentic Engineering Work Plans before code

ecosystem.title: 🧩 GMO Ecosystem
ecosystem.text: Everything Factory builds and evolves: three core applications, two cross-cutting business capabilities and one AI intelligence layer.
items: 3 core applications: POS GMO, SmartLoans, Arcade / Casino
ecosystem.note: Laundry, Grocery and Retail are companies using POS GMO. They are not separate GMO applications.

pos.title: 🏪 POS GMO: Multi-company Business Platform
pos.text: The multi-company business platform of GMO, serving Company 1 → Company N with tenant-isolated data.
items: Clients, follow-up, map, QR and KYC
Sales, expenses, orders and tickets (SMS · WhatsApp · email)
Products, inventory, suppliers and manufacturing costs
AI agents: support, inventory registration, restock alerts, service payments

loans.title: 💰 SmartLoans: Loans between people
loans.text: Connects people who need a loan with people who want to lend their money, with AI helping along the way. SmartLoans is not a bank: the money goes from one person to another.
items: SPEI · STP · AMEX · CoDi · Debit · CLABE
loans.note: AI does not determine credit limits. Money movement remains approval-controlled.

arcade.title: 🎰 Arcade / Casino: Gaming & Entertainment
arcade.text: A dedicated GMO application for gaming and entertainment, connected to the customer ecosystem through Rewards.
items: Its own workflows and business rules
arcade.note: Arcade / Casino credits are not money and not Rewards points.

rewards.title: 🎁 Rewards: Cross-App Loyalty
rewards.text: The loyalty capability that connects customer activity across GMO applications. It is cross-cutting, not a fourth application.
rewards.note: Uses the income as the source event and never touches the accounting ledger.

notif.title: 🔔 Notifications: Customer Communication
notif.text: A cross-cutting capability that turns ecosystem events into the next customer contact.
items: Driven by POS and Rewards events

ai.title: 🤖 AI Agents: Agentic Intelligence Layer
ai.text: Specialized agents that reason, orchestrate and assist across the ecosystem, using governed tools only.
